title: System projection transport through graph refinements
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$ and its algebraic closure $k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $\ell$ be prime and $E$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Fix simultaneous system operations $o$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and a realization $z$ over this field datum [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Write $\mathscr S_W$ for the derived category of strict semilinear systems of $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$-module sheaves on the pro-etale site of $W$. Use precisely support, change, projection and triangleWord as constructed in [def-pur-system-projection-formula-maps]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism. For any compactifications $d,e$ of $f$, $M\in\mathscr S_X$ and $N\in\mathscr S_Y$, one has $\operatorname{projection}_d(M,N);\operatorname{change}_{d,e}(M\otimes f^*N)=(\operatorname{change}_{d,e}(M)\otimes1_N);\operatorname{projection}_e(M,N)$. Here semicolon denotes composition in written order, and change is through the canonical graph common refinement, with the actual inverse of its second comparison. The equality holds in $\mathscr S_Y$ before evaluation, without normalized, constructible or finite-Tor assumptions on the inputs.

proof.text: By lem-sf-system-proper-open-support, the gamma in each refinement and hence the entire reverse refinement natural transformation is invertible, on all system inputs. Expand its component and the forward projectionSystemRefinement; cancel the direct-image compositor, equality casts, gamma and identity-push comparison to identify the latter with inverseOnDomain of the former.

Apply the refinement clause of lem-sf-projection-system-generating-equations to a refinement r:d->e. Substitute the inverse identification from the first step; this gives the forward projection square. Apply it to infFst d e and infSnd d e. Precompose the desired common-refinement square by tensor of the inverse of the first reverse refinement. Substitute the two forward squares, expand change, and cancel adjacent inverse pairs using tensor functoriality. This is exactly projection_change with its original statement.

lean.statement:
theorem projection_change (d e : Compactification f)
    (M : System l E X) (N : System l E Y) :
    projection l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons d M N ≫
      change l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons z.canonicalBridge z.properOpen d e
        ((calculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, (pull l E f).obj N)) =
    (calculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.map
      (Prod.mkHom
        (change l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons z.canonicalBridge z.properOpen
          d e M) (𝟙 N)) ≫
      projection l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons e M N
